[i]White hair and guns, souls trapped within circuits, and high octane game play, inspired by Unreal engine classics.[/i]

A limited time offer, containing two games officially featuring everyone's favorite cyborg assassin Marie.

[h2]GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead[/h2]
With her soul resurrected inside a long-abandoned arena shooter, Molly ventures onto a dimention-hopping quest to escape. Deeply rooted in 90s shooters like Unreal, Ghostware goes beyond just mayhem and explosive action, telling story of powerful technomagic through endless unlockable secrets and metroidvania design.

Marie too finds herself trapped in a world where political ideologies are resurrected from the ashes of annihilation. Following the  immersive sim design principles, Peripeteia mixes the design of Deus Ex and level design of E.Y.E.

notes.title: This trippy boomer shooter gets three new maps in free summer update
notes.content:
I don't know about you, but when I die, I don't want to resurrect in a videogame. It's not that I don't love them - obviously I do, otherwise I wouldn't be writing about them - it's more that they can be pretty dangerous places, even for those who've returned from the other side. In Ghostware Arena of the Dead that's exactly what's happened to the game's main character, and it's up to you to find out what the heck is going on. Released back in June, it just got its first major update with a slew of new maps to test your mettle in, along with some extremely summery skins.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead launches Episode 2 TODAY!
notes.content:
[h2]You’ve died. You’ve come back. And now, you’ve escaped to the real world.
Continue your adventure with Molly, as EPISODE 2 launches today![/h2]

Explore [b]12 brand new maps[/b] (and secrets, for you all completionists out there ;) ), as you unravel the mysteries of the Island during the second arc of the Ghostware’s story. Experience its sceneries in daytime or darkness of the night, depending on when you hold your gameplay session in the real world.

[previewyoutube=wz77MiXn3UE;full][/previewyoutube]

As you roam the area, you’ll encounter new enemies, which you’ll be able to defeat with the help of [b]5 brand new[/b] weapons we’ve teased before. Not only does your arsenal grow, but so does your skill set – a diagonal jump is available now to toggle on in the options, so you can experience a more traditional style of strafe-jumping. There’re some new abilities ready for you to unlock throughout Episode 2 story, which’ll grant access to the never seen before areas for you to discover. [b]The addition of a semi-permanent inventory system[/b] allows you to keep your current weapons of the real world safe and sound once you get back to the arena - this way you won’t be left empty-handed as you re-enter the reality again.

If you’re here not only for GHOSTWARE’s arena shenanigans, but also its immersive plot, be ready for some new twists to the story. [b]Episode 2 adds on to the cast of the characters[/b], each of them ready to expand the world’s lore for you.

We hope you’re as excited as we are to jump back into the arena and its fusillade. Take your time drinking in all the novelties and tell us how your return to the world of GHOSTWARE is going!

DAEV TEAM X HYPERSTRANGE

notes.title: Early Access Update v 0.1.1.27
notes.content:
EA v0.1.1.27 CHANGELOG:

REBALANCING & QOL
---
1) Difficulty levels rebalanced: all damage received by player is passed through a multiplier which scales with difficulty. 
Easy: damage*0.75 
Medium: damage*1.0
Hard: damage*1.5
Nightmare: damage*2.0

2) Added a third control point in "Dominance Zone" and adjusted the match accordingly.
-Team AI for King of The Hill rebalanced
-Rumbletron plays with Molly and Flak Jack from the start during the match in Dominance Zone

3) QOL changes
-added glass panel in the tutorial route to teach new players about breakable glasses
-added brief description upon picking a new weapon in the real world 
-"spread" section of the HUD now correctly hidden when player is in the real world
-HUD is hidden when the player is in a lobby or a hub level
-R-Frames don't do tactical rolls like humans anymore

4) Weapons from Episode One have been rebalanced to make them more effective and reliable during combat.
-BUFF: Shotgun number of pellets increased 8 to 12, each pellet got its hitbox increased and its dmg has decreased from 10 to 9
-BUFF/NERF: Shocking Truth primary dmg increased from 8 to 12, secondary dmg decreased 25 to 12 so it's the same value
-BUFF: Ricocheter primary dmg increased 6 to 9, hitbox increased. Secondary dmg increased 9 to 11
-NERF: Bubblegun projectile size decreased from 1.5 to 1.35, rate of fire increased from 0.375 to 0.425
-BUFF: SMG primary dmg increased from 6 to 12

NEW CONTENT
---
1)First crossover event in the Arcade:
-Incision Guy is available as a playable character
-Incision-themed map "DM_Meat" is available in Deathmatch

2)Other characters from the campaign are available in the Arcade:
-the Wizard
-R-Frame
-Islander
-etc.


BUGFIXING
---
-WASD movement keys remapping fixed
-Dash "super jump" mechanic fixed/removed
-Audio of the Wizard commenting your victory against Major Commando now plays properly
-bullet cases sfx fixed
-default duration of pop up tutorials extended
-fixed slomo upon death of certain enemies
-fixed weapon textures loading incorrectly
-minor bugfix reguarding the music in CTF3
-various typos
-fixed various places where the player could clip through
-various minor fixes and softlocks

notes.title: GHOSTWARE.exe launches in Early Access in less than 24h!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Hyperstrangers,[/h2]

[b]In less than 24 hours GHOSTWARE: Arena of the Dead will launch in Early Access.[/b] This marks another step on the development road. A road that started with a small project which was meant to be a nostalgic discourse and satire on the state of late '90s shooters. A project that now goes by the name of GHOSTWARE. Many days have passed since its conception and many will pass until the game is ready for full release.

[b]Until then, let's together enjoy the journey ahead of us. Here is what you can expect from Early Access for GHOSTWARE - compiled into an FAQ:[/b]

[h3]Why Early Access in the first place?[/h3]

GHOSTWARE is developed by a handful of people in their spare time. Early Access will allow the team to grow and fully focus on development. Not to mention that your feedback will be essential in making the game as good as it can be.

[h3]How long will this game be in Early Access?[/h3]

GHOSTWARE will be in development for a period of around 8 months, which would translate to a full release in late Q4 2023 or early Q1 2024.

[h3]How is the full version planned to differ from the Early Access version?[/h3]

The full version will have significantly more content for you to enjoy. Besides a greater roster of enemies, you can expect more grandiose boss fights, new maps, story episodes, and various other elements that are not yet present. Furthermore, the Arcade mode will receive a plethora of updates as well.

As to the price difference, [b]on the 12th of April you will be able to get the game for 14.99$ with a 15% launch discount[/b]. At the end of the development cycle you can expect the game’s price to rise slightly. 

[h3]What is the current state of the Early Access version?[/h3]

On the 12th of April you will have access to the first episode, which will include: 

[list]
[*] 4 chapters, 12+ levels, most of which can be revisited to hunt for extra items.
[*] A full “base” arsenal.
[*] Classic arena game modes such as Deathmatch, King of the Hill, Capture the Flag
[*] 8 enemy types
[*] The Arcade mode which will allow you to set up your own custom matches against bots
[/list]
[h3]Can I be involved in the development process?[/h3]

As we have mentioned at the beginning, your input will be invaluable. We will be listening to your feedback on various platforms ([url=https://discord.com/invite/qv448rMVSb]Discord[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/Ghostware_]Twitter[/url], etc.) in order to deliver a better game. Keep an eye out for closed betas for upcoming episodes as well!

[h3]This wraps up today's update and for those who can't wait, here is a short gameplay teaser:[/h3]

[previewyoutube=EvL_0SdaLe0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Yours truly,[/h2]

Hey everyone, Daev Team here!

It's been a long while since the last update, and many things happened since June.

notes.title: GHOSTWARE's release delayed (but worry not, it's still coming)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, project lead here:

Some of you might remember that [i]Ghostware[/i] was set to release in Early Access on June 24th 2022, however we've decided to postpone the release. Some opportunities have presented itself to us which may increase our chances at successfuly launching Gware, as this is a project we have invested a lot of hopes and time into, and we want to make sure to play to all of our strenghts, even if this means delaying the launch plans. We believe the possible outcomes will be worth the extra wait, so don't worry!

Still, apologies for the inconvience, we know some of you were eager to get your hands on Episode 1 as soon possible, but hopefully the new date won't be too far off!

[list]
[*] FAQ 1: [i]When's the new date?[/i] We don't know atm, but we will soon
[*] FAQ 2: [i]Did something bad happen?[/i] Not at all, if anything I'd say the opposite
[*] FAQ 3: [i]Why is the release date shifted by a whole year?[/i] when we asked Steam support to change the date after having explained the situation to them they gave us a large enough time frame by adding 365 more days
[/list]

If you have any more questions feel free to write them down in the comments!

notes.title: GHOSTWARE has a release date!
notes.content:
Hello everyone

We're delighted to announce that we settled on a date to release GHOSTWARE in Early Access, so grab a pen and mark your calendar:

The game will debut on Steam on [b]June 24th 2022[/b]! 

On this day you will find the entirety of [i]Episode One[/i] as the main course, and a first iteration of the [i]Arcade Mode[/i] as an extra!

[list]
[*] [i]Episode One[/i] of the story will feature all the content shown during the Closed Beta, which amounts to more than a dozen replayable maps with branching storylines depending on the players's choice and optional backtracking with lots of lore bits to satisfy the completionists among you.

[*] The [i]Arcade[/i] is an entirely new part of the game, dedicated to setting up custom matches throughout a handful of game modes such as Deathmatch, Domination, Capture The Flag and the likes, allowing you to choose the rules, the level of difficulty, and what character you play as.

This part features arcade-exclusive maps, and it's the portion of the game that will see the most frequent [i]content updates[/i] throughout the development cycle to keep you coming back while we work on [i]Episode Two[/i] of the story, which obviously requires case-by-case work that goes beyond making new maps for an already established framework.
[/list]

And last but not least, we will participate at the [b]Steam Next Fest[/b] (running June 13-21) with a demo that will showcase both the campaign and the custom matches, so keep an eye on that too!


We hope that you'll enjoy what we've prepared for you, and as always, keep in touch with us on [url=Twitter.com/Ghostware_]Twitter[/url] and [url=discord.gg/qv448rMVSb]Discord[/url], and tell your friends about it!


[i]_Daev Team[/i]
